data.name: Cesia
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Ceres, the goddess of agriculture, granted the title of ‘Cesia’ to those who faithfully tended the fields, symbolizing the connection between human labor and divine providence. The name also evokes the idea of a celestial sea, reflecting the spiritual waters of Christian faith.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name rooted in both ancient agricultural tradition and the Christian faith, Cesia represents a steadfast connection to the divine, nurturing the seeds of growth and faith in equal measure.

in_hebrew.name: צesia
in_hebrew.meaning: פרפר, ציפור שיר מקראית, שיר הל praise
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם צesia נגזר מהמילה העברית 'צִפְּאָר', שפירושה ציפור. הוא קשור לשירת הל praise ויש לו קונוטציות של חופש, שמחה וקישור אל האלוקים. השם מופיע בכתבי הקודש כסמל לשמחה ושבח.

in_greek.name: Κεσία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κεσία έχει τις ρίζες του στην ελληνική λέξη 'ψαλμός', που σημαίνει ψαλμός ή τραγούδι. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, οι ψαλμοί αναφέρονται συχνά ως μορφή προσευχής και επαίνου προς τον Θεό. Το όνομα συνδέεται με την ιδέα της πνευματικής χαράς και της επαφής με το Θείο.

in_latin.name: Cesia
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Cesia is derived from Latin roots associated with 'cantus', meaning song or melody. In early Christian tradition, music and song were integral to worship and praise. The name Cesia reflects the joy and spiritual connection inherent in Christian hymns and psalms.

in_english.name: Cesia
in_english.meaning: A melodic and cheerful name symbolizing joy and praise

Historically, names with such musical connotations were often given to girls born into families of devout Christians, reflecting the importance of hymns and psalms in their spiritual lives. Today, Cesia is cherished for its lyrical beauty and profound spiritual significance.

data.cultural_impact: The traditional name Cesia holds significant cultural value in the Roman and Greek pantheons as a tribute to Ceres, the goddess of agriculture. This name has been adopted into various Christian cultures as a reminder of the interconnectedness between productive work and divine blessings.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Cesia carries a deeper, spiritual resonance. While acknowledging the historical connection to Ceres, it also symbolizes a faithful trust in the divine providence and blessings that nourish and sustain our daily lives. The name may be interpreted as a reflection of the rich, celestial waters of spiritual blessings that sustenance and guide us on our faith journey.
